<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Halfling Street Watcher](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3044)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Halflings' keen sight makes them excellent street watchers. Though the job rarely calls for fighting, most street watchers cover themselves head to ankle in whatever armor and weapons they manage to get their hands on.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 13

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 8
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Halfling_Street_Watcher.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature -1">[Halfling Street Watcher](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3044)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Halfling" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=621" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 192

**Perception** +8

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Halfling](/Languages.aspx?ID=7)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +5, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +4, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +3, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +5, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +5

<row gap="medium">
**Str** -1

**Dex** +3

**Con** +1

**Int** +0

**Wis** +3

**Cha** +1
</row>

**Items**
[Frying Pan](/Weapons.aspx?ID=286), [Halfling Sling Staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=78), [Leather Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 15 

**Fort** +3 

**Ref** +8 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 8

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
frying pan +9 ([fatal d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=178)),
**Damage** 1d4–1 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
halfling sling staff +7 ([Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 80 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)),
**Damage** 1d10–1 bludgeoning

**Keen Eyes**   The halfling gains a +2 circumstance bonus when using the [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) action to find [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) or [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) creatures within 30 feet of it. Whenever the halfling targets a creature that is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) or hidden from them, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a [hidden](/Actions.aspx?ID=2175) one.

</column>
